collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE VI: LAVASTONES AND THE SCHOOLS OF THOUGHT (LCF-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Lavastones, the glowing orange-pink stones of Isola's lore, found on beaches and falling from the sky, and what they cost; and the island's schools of thought, Nature, Science, Spiritualism and Magic, arguing with and borrowing from each other.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A fisher's catch has been amazing since they found a lavastone: credit the stone, or credit their own skill.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Ever since (subject) found a small lavastone in a fish's belly, (subject.his/her) catches have been the best in the village. (subject) is sure the stone is lucky. (friend) points out that (subject) also started fishing at dawn instead of midmorning, around the same time. What does the village believe?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: The village believes it is the stone. Everyone wants to touch it. (subject) starts keeping it hidden. Then one day (subject.he/she) loses it in the lagoon, and the next week (subject.his/her) catch is still excellent. (subject) is very confused. (friend) is very smug.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) convinces (subject) to try without the stone for a week. (subject) catches almost as much. Almost. (subject) puts the stone back in (subject.his/her) pouch anyway, just in case. Nobody can prove it either way.
